title: (No AI) Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
author: Lauren Feiner
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2297774940.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

After Nvidia's board [accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031689/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-resigns), following reports that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, President Donald Trump, too, appeared to submit to the new reality. Appearing on [Stephen A. Smith's radio show](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q2xPvRnU4oI) shortly after the news came out, Trump said that Huang would "end up on his feet."

"You know the expression, anybody can be replaced," Trump said, [floating Apple's ex-CEO Tim Cook](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1032774/president-donald-trump-tim-cook-nvidia-jensen-huang) as a potential CEO candidate.

It didn't take long for Trump to begin softening his approach, making it clear he'd welcome Huang back into the role of CEO even if Nvidia's own board wasn't ready to do so. Behind the scen …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1040652/jensen-huang-nvidia-trump-reinstated)

title: (No AI) Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back. What happens next?
author: Richard Lawler
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/STKP210_JENSEN_HUANG_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

After the leather-jacketed CEO, president, and co-founder of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, [acknowledged an affair](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029595/full-text-jensen-huang-affair-memo-nvidia) with Megaspeed exec Alice Huang, his company initially announced an investigation. However, after _[The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/technology/jensen-huang-nvidia-affair.html)_ reported there was evidence of another affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported directly to him, a board meeting [that night](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1031652/jensen-huang-rumor) ended with [Huang’s resignation](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031689/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-resigns), and Nvidia CFO Colette Kress was installed as the new interim CEO.

And then… Huang was back.

In recent years, Nvidia has become a key part of the Trump administration’s AI push, a central figure in negotiations over potential Chinese access to cutting-edge AI hardware, and a company that has used its now $4 trillion-plus market cap to finance other AI companies. Saying it received input “from senior levels of the United States government,” Nvidia’s board announced his return as CEO on November 23rd, less than two weeks after his resignation.
